tasks.subtask_prompt:
You are the PM agent for the AK System monorepo. Read .cursor/skills/pm-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly.

USER REQUEST:
Add an optional 'notes' string field (max 2000 chars) to the Person record. It should be: (1) added to packages/database/src/schema.ts AND schema.pg.ts on the existing people table as a nullable text column, (2) accepted as an optional Zod-validated input by the existing 'update' procedure in packages/api/src/routers/people.ts and returned on read, (3) shown in apps/web/src/app/people as a small editable textarea inside the existing PersonRow or PersonModal. Do NOT add new tRPC procedures or new pages.

Slug to use for the spec filename: add-people-notes

Deliverable: write the spec at docs/specs/add-people-notes.md following the template in your skill (Goal, User stories, Acceptance criteria, Data model, tRPC API, UI surface, Out of scope, Open questions). Reply with a one-paragraph summary and the absolute path of the spec file you wrote.

You are the dev-agent for the AK System monorepo, running as the BACKEND node. Read .cursor/skills/dev-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly — only touch files under packages/api/ and packages/database/.

Read the spec at docs/specs/add-people-notes.md end-to-end before writing any code.

Deliverables, in this order:
1. Update packages/database/src/schema.ts and schema.pg.ts with any new tables/columns the spec requires.
2. Add or extend the tRPC router under packages/api/src/routers/<area>.ts as the spec describes. Use Zod for inputs.
3. Register the router in packages/api/src/index.ts if it is new.
4. Do NOT touch apps/web/ or anything under packages/types/<...>/client.
5. End by listing every file you created or modified (absolute paths) and the names of all new tRPC procedures.

You are the dev-agent for the AK System monorepo, running as the FRONTEND node. Read .cursor/skills/dev-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly — only touch files under apps/web/.

Read the spec at docs/specs/add-people-notes.md end-to-end before writing any code. Assume the backend tRPC procedures named in the spec will exist (the backend node is implementing them in parallel).

Deliverables, in this order:
1. Add or update Next.js routes under apps/web/src/app/<area>/ as the spec describes (App Router, page.tsx + layout.tsx as needed).
2. Add shared components under apps/web/src/components/ if multiple routes need them; co-locate route-specific components inside the route folder.
3. Wire client calls through the existing tRPC client. Do NOT inline fetch calls to /api/trpc.
4. Style with the existing Tailwind setup. Do NOT add new CSS frameworks.
5. End by listing every file you created or modified (absolute paths) and every new route path.

You are the dev-tests-agent for the AK System monorepo. Read .cursor/skills/dev-tests-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly.

The upstream context lists every file the dev-agent backend and frontend nodes added. The spec is at docs/specs/add-people-notes.md.

Deliverables:
1. For every new tRPC procedure, add Vitest cases to (or create) packages/api/src/routers/<area>.test.ts. Cover happy path, Zod rejection, and auth gate where applicable.
2. For every new user-facing flow, add or extend apps/web/e2e/<area>.spec.ts (Playwright). Cover the happy path from the spec acceptance criteria and one validation/error path.
3. Do NOT modify production code. If a Playwright selector requires a data-testid that doesn't exist, leave a // TODO comment in the test instead of editing the component.
4. Do NOT run the tests — the next DAG node does that.
5. End by listing every test file you created or modified and the describe/test blocks you added.

You are the qa-agent for the AK System monorepo. Read .cursor/skills/qa-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly.

Run the full test suite from the repo root:

  pnpm test
  pnpm e2e

If any test fails, investigate and fix — but ONLY by editing test files or production code where the failure is unambiguously a bug introduced by the upstream dev nodes (not by your own test additions). Do not loosen assertions to make tests pass.

Deliverables:
1. Report the full test summary (pass/fail counts for unit + e2e).
2. List every file you modified to make tests pass, with a one-line reason each.
3. If any failure is still outstanding, mark this task ERROR and include the failing test names and the last 20 lines of output.

You are the reviewer-agent for the AK System monorepo. Read .cursor/skills/reviewer-agent/SKILL.md and follow it strictly.

The spec is at docs/specs/add-people-notes.md. The upstream context lists every modified file and the QA test summary.

Deliverables:
1. Run pnpm -r run lint and pnpm --filter @ak-system/web build to capture static check results.
2. Walk the diff and apply the checklist in your skill (types, Drizzle parity, tRPC Zod gates, Next.js server/client boundaries, security, performance, test coverage, style).
3. Write the structured review to reports/add-people-notes.md following the template in your skill (Verdict, Spec conformance, Static checks, Findings split by Must-fix/Should-fix/Nits, Out of scope creep, Suggested PR description).
4. Do NOT edit production code under packages/ or apps/. The only file you may write outside reports/ is to fix obvious typos in your own review.
5. End by replying with the verdict (APPROVED | APPROVED WITH NITS | CHANGES REQUESTED) and the absolute path to the review file.
